description: Wait for a verification mail and extract the most likely code. Use right after triggering a signup/verification mail. A mail that arrived up to include_recent_seconds (default 60) BEFORE this call also counts, so a code delivered while you were still submitting the form is not missed; the result says arrived_before_call and age_seconds. Right after requesting a resend, pass include_recent_seconds: 0 so the previous code is not returned. If the timeout is reached with no code, ask the user to check the flow.

include_recent_seconds.description: Also accept a mail that arrived up to this many seconds before the call (0-600, default 60). Use 0 right after a resend.

poll_seconds.description: Poll interval (3-30 seconds; do not go below 3).

subject_contains.description: Only consider mails whose subject contains this text.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a new mail (10-600 seconds).

name: wait_for_otp
title: Wait for a verification code
